_comment: JSCDSEND1104 (Samu 69478): the shared SCRIPT-RUN contract of the two mail gates: outgoing-copy-gate.py :: script_run_sends (the main agent's approval gate) and email-send-gate.mjs :: scriptRunSends (the sub-agents' send gate). The conformance test (script-run-conformance.test.ts) writes `files` into a fresh directory, runs EVERY case from that directory through BOTH implementations and asserts both equal `expected`, so a divergence between the two copies is a test failure. The JS twin did not follow a `cd` before the run and did not call a missing script a send; both are pinned here. Script contents are fixtures, nothing is executed. Samu 69538 / 69623: every case has TWO expected verdicts. `main` is the main agent's approval gate (the python twin; true = asks for approval), `sub` the sub-agent gate (the JS twin; true = denies). They differ only where a fail-closed branch (an undecidable cd or -m, a missing or unreadable script) meets an unaddressed run: the main gate keeps it fail-closed, the sub-agent gate does not. ISSUE2582 (Samu 72403): an undecidable script path is a send on both gates, addressed or not. The input reading is shared.
